specs.prompt:
Create ONE beautiful 16:9 landscape GAME KEY ILLUSTRATION for 《交子赶工记》 based on reference1's playful sunny pop-up book and cut-paper sticker character composition. This is an ILLUSTRATION, not UI, no buttons or interface labels. Follow its luminous warm cream/gold background, a huge open pop-up book in foreground, four lively characters around its paper scenery, cream cutout rims and joyful paper theatre feeling. DO NOT include the reference's human hands, human characters, rabbit mascots or extra animals. EXACTLY four animals from references2-5 are the only characters.
Lock each animal to supplied sheet: 泡泡 female OTTER, small round ears, low broad muzzle, orange-brown fur, blue ear ribbon, indigo work robe and teal sash, short sturdy body tapered tail, carries thin bamboo papermaking frame with both paws. 递蕉 male GOLDEN SNUB-NOSED MONKEY, golden tuft, blue-grey face, jade work tunic/red scarf, slim small body with long THIN curling tail, happily passes ONE blank sheet toward center. 墨墩 female PANDA, black eye patches/round ears, dark teal fabric ear knot, vermilion robe with teal apron, rounded body, confidently holds a thin flat printing block and brush, no thick decorative tablet. 烘栗 male RED PANDA, orange face with cream markings, jade robe, broad ring-striped fluffy tail, holds folding fan and playful proud expression. Maintain clearly different animal faces, proportions and silhouettes, expressive cute flat handpainted anatomy, no replacement with human-like hairstyles/bodies.
Composition: open ivory book spreads across bottom third, central fold clearly visible, thick page edge slim and clean. A miniature Song wooden printing workshop pops up from center: warm vermilion timber, grey-blue simple eaves, a small papermaking trough on left, two hanging blank sheets behind, printing table on right. All stand-ups are flat painted paper panels with small supports and selective contact shadows. A wide continuous cream paper ribbon flows through the center from left trough toward right printing table with simple readable folds, no tangled ribbons. A few tall large GOLD GINKGO PAPER LEAVES frame the scenery, not dense blossoms. Teal mountain cutouts and a large golden disk create background shapes with ample open cream sky.
Four animal sticker paper figures arranged diagonally around the book like ref1: otter lower left, panda lower right standing lightly on book edge; monkey upper left and red panda upper right on elevated paper folds, supported by paper scenery rather than held by hands. Keep their full bodies and tails readable, no cropping. Bring them close enough to interact and share focus toward central paper, NOT four separate portraits or rigid card grid. Flat cream paper rims around characters about 2-3% of head width, little offset warm shadow for cutout effect, characters themselves FLAT colored gouache/ink with minimal shading. No plastic 3D fur, no clay rendering. Subtle varied ink lines, solid color shapes, natural lovely expressions, rounded brave craftsmanship, real visual narrative of paper → printing.
GLOBAL consistency: same family as warm paper UI with ivory #F4E6C8, ink brown #34251D, muted jade #2D7770, vermilion #B5452C, golden #D6A545, blue-grey accents. Keep fresh color and sunny contrast, not muddy or overall grey. Clean smooth flat paper areas, large meaningful shapes, crisp legible silhouettes, generous negative space. NO dirty grain, no high-frequency fibers, no dense decorations, no hatching all over, no floating confetti, no glitter, no photoreal wood. A few tiny tasteful floating ginkgo leaves only if composition needs them. No text, title, watermark, UI controls, human hands, human gods or extra mascots. An authored refined Chinese papercraft storybook illustration suitable for game opening/title background.

specs.prompt:
EDIT this exact four-animal Chinese papercraft game illustration. Preserve the FOUR character identities, clothing colors, expressive faces, cream cutout edges, their general positions and the wide OPEN POP-UP BOOK. The user says the ARCHITECTURAL STRUCTURE IS WRONG and BACKGROUND TOO BUSY. Correct these two issues decisively while retaining the sunny hand-painted gouache paper-theatre style.
BACKGROUND: remove the giant golden sun disk, remove ALL oversized ginkgo-leaf clusters and most clouds, remove the layered continuous mountain wall. Use luminous near-plain warm cream negative space occupying about 45 percent of entire image, with ONLY one faint low distant jade mountain silhouette in the far lower background and ONE restrained small ginkgo branch at far left edge, no leaf directly behind each character. Very few background shapes. No floral fill, no confetti, no halo, no pattern texture. Don't replace decorations with another busy ornament.
ARCHITECTURE: replace the current incoherent interlocking floating roof fragments with ONE compact, structurally coherent Song-inspired simple three-bay timber workshop centered in the book, below the two upper characters. ONE clear rectangular footprint. ONE continuous simple gabled roof with two connected slopes and a SINGLE straight horizontal ridge, grey-blue tiles indicated by widely spaced tidy lines. Roof loads rest on a continuous front beam, clearly seated on FOUR upright timber posts at front; matching rear posts explain building depth. Left bay has a simple lattice wall, middle bay open, right bay open with the printing bench. Visible small sidewall at right recedes consistently to SAME vanishing point as roof and floor. Posts end on the book's ground plane / a thin paper ground patch; no floating beam ends, no arbitrary extra roofs, no beams passing through animals. Mildly upturned eaves only, no ornate dragon ridges. Structural solidity must be obvious even as a flat paper pop-up.
Show the drying rack as a SEPARATE simple low freestanding frame in front-left of building with TWO blank hanging sheets, with two posts on the floor; NOT a roof supporting another roof. Print table clearly four legs with front stretcher, thin printing block on flat tabletop, behind panda. Otter's papermaking tub remains foreground left. The central continuous paper strip still goes from monkey's paws toward table, but cleanly arcs through OPEN SPACE ABOVE/BESIDE building and never slices through roof or beam.
Four characters remain exact: otter bottom-left indigo, monkey top-left jade/red scarf, panda bottom-right red/teal, red panda top-right green with fan and ring tail. Upper monkey/red panda must stand on visible modest folded-paper risers connected down to the open book, NOT on unsupported loose roofs. Avoid duplicating characters or props. If needed make the central workshop slightly smaller so it is fully readable between the animals. Keep head/body proportions, expressions, tools and costumes unchanged.
Clean medium-width hand ink contours, large flat painted shapes, only soft paper cast shadows and light folds, no high frequency texture/no dirty grain/no plastic3D. Same warm ivory, gold, jade, vermilion, slate palette. No text, people, real hands, logos or UI. Finished 16:9 illustration with relaxed breathing space and correct connected architecture.
